el.¿Qué es el Posgrado en Yoga Esencial?: What is the Postgraduate in Yoga Esencial?
el.Son tres meses de formación avanzada, on: It's three months of advanced training, online and live, devoted to three tools for teaching: Yoga Nidra and creative visualizations, Yoga with props and Chair Yoga.
el.¿Puedo hacer el Posgrado sin haber hecho: Can I take the Postgraduate without having done the Teacher Training?
el.Sí, si ya tenés una formación previa en: Yes, if you already have previous Yoga training or are already teaching. If you're coming from the Teacher Training, it's the natural next step: same day, same time and same group.
el.De septiembre a noviembre de 2027, los m: From September to November 2027, Tuesdays from 19 to 21 hs, Argentina time. One topic per month.
el.¿Cuánto sale el Posgrado?: How much does the Postgraduate Program cost?
el.Un pago de $395.000 o tres cuotas de $14: One payment of $395.000 or three installments of $143.000. If you take the Instructor Training and the Postgraduate Program together, the complete path costs $1.290.000.
el.¿Puedo cursar un solo módulo?: Can I take just one module?
el.Sí. Los módulos del Posgrado también se: Yes. The Postgraduate Program modules are also offered individually as courses of the month. What you paid for a single course is deducted from the first installment of the Postgraduate Program.
el.No. El retiro de diciembre en Villa de M: No. The December retreat in Villa de Merlo, San Luis, is optional and paid separately. It is open to both Instructor Training and Postgraduate Program students.
